lines.say: Your city's cameras now rate your smile. A low score costs money.
Monday morning. Your smile scores four out of ten. Two dollars.
You smile all day. Your face hurts. The cameras still find a frown.
Doris from six C scores ten out of ten. Every day. She painted a smile on her mask.
Then you see the score of the man who owns the tower. Zero. Exempt.
Would you fake your smile? Write it in the comments.
